description: Copies one module's settings into its neighbours: it takes the preset of the module on its left and pastes it into every module of the same kind to its right

params.text: Copies the preset of the module on its left into the module on its right, and on rightwards for as long as each next module is of the same kind as the one before it

inputs.text: A crossing above 1V starts the copy

outputs.text: 10V for one millisecond each time a copy is made, for passing on to another Copy Paste Preset

notes: it needs a module on its left to copy from and a module of the same kind on its right to paste into. The run stops at the first module on the right of a different kind.
whatever was on the system clipboard is put back afterwards.
the module has no menu of its own beyond Rack's.

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
